used_on: 35 roadway pieces SW_road_*: 15,853 m2, the largest uninterrupted roadway run is Wieland, about 300 m long and 8 m wide
variation_method_and_seed: Mapped from above in world metres, so no piece has its own seam. Each image set is read twice: the second reading is turned a quarter, 1.37 times the size and shifted by 0.413 / 0.719 of an image; the two are mixed through the cloud picture T_W1529_Noise at 4 m (VariationSize_m 4); slow change of brightness 0.12 (MacroVariation) at about 17 m. No random seed: the pattern is fixed by world position
close_and_wide_evidence: close: gate/jpg/G5_road_low_neutral.jpg; wide: gate/jpg/G6_wide_neutral.jpg (309 m square) and G7_block_neutral.jpg
grazing_light_evidence: gate/jpg/*_grazing.jpg (same sun lowered to 8 degrees for the test, then put back)
renderer_and_conditions: Unreal 5.9 editor viewport, Lumen, view mode Lit, quality 3 (Epic), 1920 x 1080, automatic exposure, editor in the background
notes: No repeat and no seam found in any of the views. Road markings are not modelled.

used_on: 49 ground pieces SW_ground_* and the lot placeholder SG_lot_placeholder: 73,510 m2 in all, of which public sidewalk 7,632 m2
variation_method_and_seed: As the roadway; in addition every slab (1.524 m) is a little lighter or darker by a number worked out from its place (7 percent); joints 1.2 cm wide are intentional
